A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

content.text: I'll start by listing the tables and their schemas.

input.query: SELECT 'n' p, service_name, attr_span_kind kind, count(*) n, avg(duration)/1e6 avg_ms, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code<>'Unset' AND attr_status_code<>'Ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errs, sum(CASE WHEN attr_http_response_status_code>=500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) http5xx FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'a', service_name, attr_span_kind, count(*), avg(duration)/1e6, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code<>'Unset' AND attr_status_code<>'Ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN attr_http_response_status_code>=500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,1,3
SELECT 'n' p, service_name, level, count(*) FROM normal_logs GROUP BY 1,2,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'a', service_name, level, count(*) FROM abnormal_logs GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,1,3

content.text: Frontend server spans show 780 HTTP 5xx in the incident, while `search`, `geo`, `rate` and `reservation` nearly vanish from abnormal traces. Next I'll look at the error spans and their parent/child chain.

input.query: SELECT service_name, attr_span_kind, span_name, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, attr_http_response_status_code code, attr_status_code st, count(*) n, avg(duration)/1e6 ms FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4 LIMIT 200

SELECT service_name, attr_span_kind, span_name, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, attr_http_response_status_code code, attr_status_code st, count(*) n, avg(duration)/1e6 ms FROM normal_traces GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4 LIMIT 200

content.text: The key pattern: in the incident, every `search.Search/Nearby` client call from frontend returns an Error in about 0.02 ms, with no downstream spans. Search, geo and rate have almost no spans. I'll check search's logs and the restart and uptime metrics.

input.query: SELECT 'log' t, service_name, level, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, substr(message,1,160) msg, count(*) n, min(time) first_t, max(time) last_t FROM abnormal_logs WHERE level<>'INFO' OR service_name IN ('search','geo','rate','reservation') OR service_name='' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 60

SELECT service_name, metric, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, count(*) n, avg(value) avgv, min(value) minv, max(value) maxv FROM abnormal_metrics WHERE metric IN ('k8s.container.restarts','k8s.pod.uptime') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3
